answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. A vine of per-task receipts records who did what, and the dune of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. What survives to the horizon is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
